description: The stored text of a bill alone, windowed by `start` and `max_chars` (default 60,000), with a pointer to continue.

bill.description: The bill or resolution: HB 136, H.B. 136, House Bill 136, SR 5, 2025-2026/hb136, or a numeric id.
bill.title: Bill

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in this call, 1,000 to 200,000 (default 60,000). A longer document ends with a pointer to the next part.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

session.description: The session, named by its years or slug: 2025-2026 (the regular session) or 2026-special. Omit for the default the tool describes.
session.title: Session

start.description: Where to start, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the beginning.
start.title: Start

name: bills_get_text
title: Read a bill's text
